text_block_list.text:
After school, I saw Inari One talking with 
her classmates.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... It's finally damn well over. 
Guess I'll head to a public bath.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Maybe I'll come along too! It's the 
usual super hot public bathhouse, right!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's what I'm aiming for, but... hmm...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Instead of a hot bath to freshen up, I'm 
feeling more like a nice, long soak to go 
completely limp today..."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll try taking a lukewarm bath for 
a change...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I-Inari-chan, wasn't lukewarm 
bathwater totally unforgivable to you...?

Inari One seems to be fatigued from 
running in consecutive races. It might be 
wise to reconsider her race schedule.
